label: Твой
description: Possessive patterns for 'your' in second person, with agreement across noun genders and numbers.

Strategic focus: Placement and possession. 1. 'Твой' marks ownership. 2. 'Стоит' gives a stable location frame. 3. 'У окна' adds a practical spatial relation.
Strategic focus: Possessive with identity verb. 1. 'Твой друг' is a natural masculine noun phrase. 2. 'Говорит' remains third person singular. 3. 'По-русски' is a practical language-use adverb.
Strategic focus: Possession plus past state. 1. 'Твой чай' is a familiar daily phrase. 2. 'Уже' adds a time marker. 3. 'Остыл' shows masculine past tense agreement.

Strategic focus: Feminine possessive agreement. 1. 'Твоя' changes to match the feminine noun 'книга'. 2. 'Новая' also agrees with the feminine noun. 3. The sentence cleanly demonstrates possessive and adjective agreement together.

Strategic focus: Neuter possessive agreement. 1. 'Твое' is the neuter form. 2. 'Окно' requires the neuter possessive. 3. 'Открыто' gives a concise and natural state description.
Strategic focus: Neuter noun with result state. 1. 'Твое' matches the neuter noun 'письмо'. 2. 'Уже' adds a time marker. 3. 'Отправлено' gives a completed-state feel that fits real conversation.

Strategic focus: Plural possessive agreement. 1. 'Твои' is the plural possessive form. 2. 'Книги' is plural, so the agreement is visible. 3. 'На столе' keeps the sentence grounded in a real location.

Strategic focus: Plural family noun. 1. 'Твои' matches the plural noun 'родители'. 2. 'Дома' gives a simple location state. 3. This is highly practical everyday language.
Strategic focus: Plural body-part noun. 1. 'Руки' requires the plural possessive 'твои'. 2. 'Холодные' also agrees in plural. 3. This line is good for feeling agreement across the full noun phrase.
